name: Loans
overview: Scripture instructs believers to lend to those in need without charging interest, especially to fellow Israelites who are poor or struggling, emphasizing mercy and kindness rather than profit (Exodus 22:25; Leviticus 25:35; Deuteronomy 23:19). The righteous are characterized by generosity and discretion in lending, contrasting with the wicked who borrow without repaying (Psalms 37:21; Psalms 112:5). Caution is also advised when becoming surety for others, highlighting the importance of wisdom in financial commitments (Proverbs 6:1).
